plugins/ravenclaude-core/dashboard.html: P9 wave 1: 12 mechanism inventory entries. P6 adds the verification-strength badge and nuance block to every concept card (~1.8 KB of CSS + markup scaffolding). R12 makes that rendering non-optional: 96 of 162 artifacts get a weak check, and a weak check that renders identically to a strong one is the inert-gate defect wearing a badge.

merge: advisory_knobs + cheap_lane both land (forge/vba-impl <- origin/main)

Merging origin/main into forge/vba-impl combined two independently-under-budget posture round-trip features into the one dashboard serializer: the branch's advisory scalar knobs (probe_validity + four cause_* keys) and main's cheap_lane block. Each stayed under 10,400,000 on its own branch; the merged emitYaml()/applyGuardrailConfig() source pushed dashboard.html to 10,406,310 (+6,310 over the P9 wave 1 ceiling). Both features are state-slot round-trips with NO DOM control, so the island-payload table is unchanged (still 31,140 <= 31,500) and this is a pure JS-source bytes raise. Appended per the R5 reviewed-raise rule; the growth is deliberate and visible rather than a silent creep.
